evidence_candidates.excerpt: The NSDI 2026 study characterizes a switched CXL appliance and identifies intra-host contention, in-fabric congestion, and unmanaged host-to-remote-DIMM interaction. Its proposed transport uses rate control, admission control, cross-host bookkeeping, congestion signals, and link-capacity estimation.
evidence_candidates.statement_supported: Multi-host CXL pooling needs explicit interference, fairness, congestion, and admission-control parameters; single-stream latency and bandwidth are not sufficient predictors.
